clue.text: Front of legs, covered up by seaside, go white

clue.text: Rule to stop rising in court after barrister's closing bit

explanation.definitionFit: The Riot Act was a law requiring rioters to disperse, a rule to stop an uprising.

clue.text: Typically male bachelor left on Love Island

clue.text: Play main piece, not initially audible

parts.note: taken as written, as the letters to rearrange

clue.text: Start to eat fare with tin cans in hamper

clue.text: Solvent as the loan is settled

clue.text: Box office for people's sporting event
